title: Autonomous Data Selection with Zero-shot Generative Classifiers for Mathematical Texts
authors_zh: Yifan Zhang, Yifan Luo, Yang Yuan, Andrew C. Yao
paper_type_zh: 数学文本筛选与持续预训练数据选择论文（Findings of ACL 2025）
best_for_zh: 研究数学语料筛选、持续预训练和模型相对数据质量的读者。
one_line: AutoDS ranks mathematical text with zero-shot generative-classifier logits before continual pretraining.
AutoDS 用零样本生成式分类器词元概率给数学文本排序，再决定哪些数据进入持续预训练。
why: It makes the connection between a data object and its training objective inspectable.
inclusion_reason: It changes how a training record, selection decision, or reward signal is consumed by a post-training objective.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Broad web corpora contain mathematical text with very different educational value. A page with notation, a solved derivation, a research abstract, and a fragment of malformed markup can all look “mathematical” to a keyword filter, yet they do not supply the same learning signal to a language model. Human labels can distinguish them, but collecting enough labels for web-scale continual pretraining is costly; training a separate classifier also introduces another model and annotation pipeline to maintain.

The paper therefore asks whether a large generative model can act as a zero-shot data selector without task-specific supervised labels. It turns the model's relative preference for YES and NO answers to mathematical-value questions into a continuous score, then uses that score to decide which documents from several public sources enter the AutoMathText mixture for continual pretraining. The problem is data consumption: how to allocate a fixed training-token budget to more useful mathematical text.

宽泛网络语料中的数学文本教育价值差异很大。含有符号的网页、带完整推导的解答、研究摘要和格式损坏的片段，都可能被关键词过滤器识别为“数学文本”，却未必向语言模型提供同样的学习信号。人工标注能够区分它们，但为网页规模的持续预训练收集足够标注代价很高；另行训练分类器又会增加需要维护的模型和标注流程。

因此，论文追问：能否让大型生成模型在没有任务专用监督标签的情况下充当零样本数据选择器？它把模型针对数学价值问题回答“是”和“否”时的相对偏好转换为连续分数，再依据该分数决定多个公开来源中的哪些文档进入供持续预训练使用的 AutoMathText 混合语料。这里要解决的是数据消费问题：在固定训练词元预算内，怎样把预算分配给更有价值的数学文本。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AutoDS makes the selection signal an explicit companion to the text. Each candidate document is associated with an lm_q1q2_score, derived from the difference between the model's logits for the positive and negative answers to two natural-language questions about mathematical informativeness and educational value. A downstream curator can rank documents, retain a score band, or change the threshold, rather than treating every document that survived an upstream crawl as equally useful.

This is deliberately a model-relative usefulness signal, not a theorem prover and not a correctness label for every statement in a document. Its central claim is more modest: the score changes the composition of the corpus consumed by continual pretraining, and that changed composition can be evaluated under a matched training budget. The released scored corpus makes both the decision rule and the selected data inspectable rather than leaving quality filtering as an undocumented preprocessing step.

AutoDS 让选择信号成为文本的显式伴随信息。每篇候选文档都对应一个 lm_q1q2_score：该分数来自模型面对两个关于数学信息量和教育价值的自然语言问题时，对肯定答案和否定答案的词元分数差。下游整理者可以据此排序文档、保留某一分数区间或调整阈值，而不必把爬取阶段留下的所有文档都视为同样有用。

这刻意是一个相对于模型的有用性信号，不是定理证明器，也不是为文档中每个陈述给出的正确性标签。它的核心主张更为克制：该分数改变持续预训练所消费语料的组成，而这种组成变化可以在匹配的训练预算下接受评估。公开发布的带分语料使选择规则和被选数据都可被检查，而不是把质量过滤藏在没有说明的预处理步骤中。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors draw candidate documents from OpenWebMath, RedPajama arXiv, and Algebraic Stack, so the pool includes web mathematical material, scientific writing, and question-answer content. They prompt Qwen-72B with two binary questions aimed at whether a passage contains useful mathematical knowledge and whether it has educational value. Rather than sampling a verbal judgment, they read the relevant target-token logits and combine them into the LM-Score used for ranking.

After scoring more than 11.26 million documents, the authors choose score ranges to create an approximately 200 GB AutoMathText release. They continually pretrain Gemma-2B, LLaMA2-7B, and Mistral-7B on selected mixtures and compare them with uniform sampling and existing selectors under matched schedules. The official repository and dataset expose the scoring and corpus artifacts; however, the paper does not provide a complete document-level overlap audit against every downstream benchmark, so reuse still needs a contamination check.

作者从 OpenWebMath、RedPajama arXiv 和 Algebraic Stack 收集候选文档，因此候选池同时包含网页数学材料、科学写作和问答内容。他们向 Qwen-72B 提出两个二元问题，分别判断一段文字是否包含有用的数学知识、是否具有教育价值。方法并不采样一段文字化判断，而是读取相关目标词元的分数，并将其组合为用于排序的 LM-Score。

在给超过 11.26 百万篇文档打分后，作者选择若干分数区间，形成规模约为 200 GB 的 AutoMathText 发布版本。他们在选出的混合语料上持续预训练 Gemma-2B、LLaMA2-7B 和 Mistral-7B，并在相同训练日程下与均匀采样及既有选择器比较。官方仓库和数据集公开了打分与语料工件；不过论文没有给出针对每一个下游基准的完整文档级重叠审计，复用时仍需检查污染。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The clearest comparison holds the continual-pretraining recipe fixed and changes the way the mathematical corpus is selected. For Mistral-7B, AutoDS reaches 16.14 accuracy on MATH, compared with 14.26 for uniform sampling, 12.30 for DSIR, and 12.90 for QuRating. These are useful numbers because the baselines are also curation rules rather than unrelated model scales, and they show a gain under the paper's stated token and training settings.

The paper also evaluates several model sizes and uses ablations to connect the result to the proposed score. Still, the evidence establishes relative utility on the evaluated mathematical mixtures, not that an identical threshold will transfer to law, code, or multilingual data. Nor does an improvement on MATH prove that the score measures mathematical truth: it can also capture the preferences and blind spots of Qwen-72B, the model that supplied the selection signal.

最清晰的比较固定持续预训练配方，只改变数学语料的选择方式。对于 Mistral-7B，AutoDS 在 MATH 上达到 16.14 的准确率，均匀采样为 14.26，DSIR 为 12.30，QuRating 为 12.90。这些数字之所以有参考价值，是因为基线同样是数据整理规则，而非不同模型规模；它们显示了在论文所述词元数和训练设置下的收益。

论文还评估了多个模型大小，并以消融实验把结果与所提分数联系起来。不过，证据证明的是该分数在被评估数学混合语料上的相对效用，而不是同一个阈值会迁移到法律、代码或多语言数据。MATH 上的提升也不证明该分数度量的是数学真值：它同样可能反映提供选择信号的 Qwen-72B 的偏好和盲点。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier curation pipelines commonly depend on labeled preference data, heuristic source rules, embedding similarity, or a separately trained quality classifier. AutoDS changes the decision interface by asking a generative model a short binary question and reading its own next-token scores as a continuous selector. That choice keeps the scoring mechanism close to the model's generative representation while avoiding a new supervised classifier-training stage.

The novelty is therefore the publicly released scored corpus together with a reproducible, model-relative ranking rule. Continual pretraining, generic question prompting, and mathematical benchmark evaluation are not new on their own. The contribution matters when the research question is which records a training run consumes; it should not be read as a general verifier for mathematical answers or as evidence that every model will agree with Qwen-72B's ranking.

既有清洗流水线通常依赖带标注的偏好数据、启发式来源规则、嵌入相似度，或另行训练的质量分类器。AutoDS 改变选择接口：它向生成模型提出简短的二元问题，并读取模型自身下一个词元的分数作为连续选择器。这一做法让打分机制贴近模型的生成表征，同时避免再训练一个有监督分类器的阶段。

因此，新意在于公开发布的带分语料以及可复现、相对于模型的排序规则。持续预训练、通用问题提示和数学基准评测本身并不新。当研究问题是一次训练究竟消费哪些记录时，这一贡献才特别重要；它不应被理解为数学答案的通用验证器，也不能证明每个模型都会同意 Qwen-72B 给出的排序。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The score can inherit Qwen-72B's domain preferences, calibration errors, and blind spots, and the paper explicitly cautions that a new domain may require different prompts or adaptation. A high score does not certify that every equation, citation, or solution in a document is correct. Before reuse, inspect the exact score bands, source licenses, duplicated documents, and overlap with intended evaluation sets; the paper does not supply a complete contamination audit for all possible downstream benchmarks.
该分数可能继承 Qwen-72B 的领域偏好、校准误差和盲点，论文也明确提醒：换到新领域可能需要不同的提示或适配。高分并不证明文档中的每个公式、引文或解答都正确。复用前应检查具体分数区间、来源许可证、重复文档以及与目标评测集的重叠；论文没有为所有可能的下游基准提供完整的污染审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when building a documented mathematical-text mixture for continual pretraining and when a full human-labeling program is infeasible. Start from the released score and source mixture, select a band under a fixed token budget, and compare it with uniform, length-based, and domain-specific alternatives using the same base model and schedule. Treat the score as a curation signal rather than a solution-correctness label, and preserve the chosen prompt and model version so that another curator can reproduce the decision.
当要为持续预训练构建有文档说明的数学文本混合语料、却无法开展完整人工标注时，可使用这项工作。可从发布的分数和来源混合开始，在固定词元预算下选择一个区间，并用相同的基模型和训练日程与均匀采样、长度筛选和领域专用替代方法比较。应把该分数视为整理信号，而不是解答正确性标签；同时保留所用提示和模型版本，使其他整理者能够复现这一决策。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Remember the chain of decisions: candidate mathematical text is paired with a continuous score, Qwen-72B supplies that score through YES/NO logits, and score bands determine the approximately 200 GB corpus used for continual pretraining. The representative Mistral-7B result is 16.14 versus 14.26 MATH accuracy for uniform sampling, but the operational lesson is not “trust one scorer.” It is to release the selection signal, hold the training budget fixed, and audit licenses and benchmark overlap before claiming that a curation rule improves learning.
请记住这条决策链：候选数学文本先配上连续分数，Qwen-72B 通过“是/否”词元分数提供该信号，再由分数区间决定进入持续预训练的约 200 GB 语料。代表性的 Mistral-7B 结果是 AutoDS 的 MATH 准确率 16.14，对均匀采样的 14.26；但操作上的教训不是“相信一个评分器”，而是公开选择信号、固定训练预算，并在宣称某条整理规则改善学习前审计许可证和基准重叠。
